old: Provider shall maintain 99.5% uptime each calendar month.
new: Provider shall maintain 99.0% uptime each calendar month.
explanation: The lower uptime commitment reduces the guaranteed availability of the service for the customer.

old: This Agreement auto-renews for successive 12-month terms unless either party gives 60 days written notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term.
new: This Agreement auto-renews for successive 12-month terms unless either party gives 90 days written notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term.
explanation: The customer must provide notice of non-renewal earlier, reducing their flexibility to exit the agreement.

old: Customer shall pay all invoices within 30 days of the invoice date. Late payments incur a 5% late fee.
new: Customer shall pay all invoices within 15 days of the invoice date. Late payments incur a 10% late fee.
explanation: The payment window is halved and the penalty for late payments is doubled, increasing financial risk for the customer.

new: Provider may use anonymized Customer data to improve its services and train machine learning models.
explanation: This grants the provider the right to utilize the customer's data for its own product development and AI training purposes.

old: Provider's total liability is capped at 1 month of fees paid.
new: Provider's total liability is capped at 3 months of fees paid.
explanation: The liability cap is increased, allowing the customer to recover higher damages in the event of a provider breach.
